mutations.name: exit 69 is not read as an unreachable broker
kills: broker unavailable ls raises BrokerUnavailableError on exit 69 with any text

mutations.name: the no-autostart probe line is not read as an unreachable broker
mutations.find: /^broker unavailable: no broker is listening and AGENT_CHAT_NO_AUTOSTART=1 forbids starting one$/m,
kills: broker unavailable ls raises BrokerUnavailableError on the no-autostart probe line, exit 1
